subject: Portal profile lint + resilience pack for SOC2/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightleaf.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick profile lint + resilience pack request

Hi Karthik,

We're starting the Brightleaf vendor review next week and noticed a few inconsistencies in the Whistic/Vendr profile answers for Redwood — mainly around data residency, syslog retention windows, and KMS ownership. The auditor flagged mismatched answers between the CAIQ mapping and the SOC2 evidence samples we pulled.

Can you run a quick "profile lint" (small QA pass across OneTrust/Whistic/Vendr) and provide a short resilience pack we can hand to the auditors? By resilience pack I mean:
- canonical S3 manifest showing evidence possession (signed hashes),
- a short syslog retention sample + retention policy snapshot,
- KMS key ARN and rotation proof (or attestation),
- list of owners for the above items and any service accounts involved.

If you can upload to our Vendr request and send the Whistic link, that would be ideal. We're hoping to close this during the initial intake (target: EOD next Friday).

Link to the failing checks: https://whistic.com/s/brightleaf/request/12345

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Security Operations | Brightleaf Payments
[Attachment: example-evidence-template.csv (csv, 5KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quick profile lint + resilience pack request

On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 09:12, Liam O'Neill <liam@brightleaf.com> wrote:
> We're starting the Brightleaf vendor review next week and noticed a few inconsistencies...

Thanks for the heads up, Liam — we can own this. Proposed plan: short lint pass + build the resilience pack and upload artifacts to Vendr + link in Whistic.

High-level timeline (5 business days):
1) Day 0-1: run profile lint across OneTrust/Whistic/Vendr and enumerate mismatches (I will generate a short CSV).
2) Day 2: gather canonical artifacts (S3 manifest, KMS attestation, syslog sample).
3) Day 3: produce the resilience pack zip and upload (we'll include signed hashes in the manifest).
4) Day 4: post links to Vendr and Whistic, share checklist with auditors.

Owner/roles: Mina will curate the artifacts and run the S3 hash manifest. Jonas will take KMS rotation proof and confirm key ARNs. I'll coordinate uploads and the CAIQ reconciliation.

Attached: profile-lint-report-draft.pdf (outline of mismatches) and resilience-checklist.csv (task list). I'll also create a temporary presign bucket for the manifest if we need a short-lived upload.

Can you confirm the specific Whistic questions that triggered the flag (a screenshot or question IDs helps)? Otherwise we'll triage all CAIQ sections flagged by your portal link.

Next steps I will take immediately: kick off a lint job and open github ticket 842 to track the work (https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/tickets/842).

Best,
Karthik
Head of Security Integrations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: profile-lint-report-draft.pdf (pdf, 480KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightleaf.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quick profile lint + resilience pack request

Thanks Karthik — I'm on artifact collection. Quick notes and action items: 

- I've started an S3 inventory job and will produce s3-proof-manifest.csv with signed sha256 hashes (expected by EOD Thursday).
- Jonas: can you export KMS key metadata + rotation history for the last 12 months and drop it into the private bucket listed below? We need the ARN, creation date, last-rotate timestamp and the audit log snippet showing rotation event.
- I'll also pull a 7-day syslog sample plus the retention policy PDF from our compliance binder.

Temporary presign location (I'll create and DM credentials to Liam): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp-evidence/brightleaf-2026-12-presign

Uploads I will perform: s3-proof-manifest.csv, resilience-pack.zip (containing syslog sample + retention-policy.pdf + kms-rotation.txt). Once uploaded I will post the Vendr request link and the Whistic evidence URL back to this thread.

Forwarded for context: 

> On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 09:12, Liam O'Neill <liam@brightleaf.com> wrote:
> > Can you run a quick "profile lint" (small QA pass across OneTrust/Whistic/Vendr) and provide a short resilience pack we can hand to the auditors?

I'll flag any items that need design sign-off (e.g., evidence that requires a new retention SLA) and add them to ticket security/842.

Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: s3-proof-manifest.csv (csv, 12KB)]
